properties.statement:
ROOT CAUSE OF THE UNCHECKED-PROSE CLASS, and it OVERTURNS the conclusion drawn from the prevalence survey earlier the same day.

THE SURVEY MEASURED HOW MUCH PROSE IS FALSE (about 2%) AND INFERRED A REPAIR FROM THE RATE. That skipped the step that matters: nobody asked WHY these sentences are false, or generated candidate causes and took a measurement that could tell them apart. Anthony pushed on exactly that — a conclusion carrying an untested "what would refute this" is not a root cause.

**THE DISCRIMINATING QUESTION: WERE THESE SENTENCES EVER TRUE?**
· "Prose ROTS as code changes" predicts each was true when written and outgrown later.
· "Prose is BORN FALSE" predicts it never matched the code.
Opposite repairs, and `git log -S` settles it.

**MEASURED ACROSS THE SIX KNOWN INSTANCES:**

① `loop_status` "never reached the design" — **BORN FALSE, 2026-07-21 (4f6e427).** At birth, line 222 computed `questions.iter().filter(|q| q.status == "answered").count()` and line 279 asserted the answer never reached the design. **The counter and the claim it cannot support were written in ONE COMMIT, 57 LINES APART.** Unreported for 26 days.
② `describe_schema` ranking presented as modelled fit — born false structurally: the rank has always measured endpoint enumeration, and enumeration has never been what it is presented as.
③ `authored_by` "never enlarges a blast radius" — **NOT FALSE.** True of propagation; it misleads by omission. Counted honestly rather than folded in.
④ `unresolved_setup` "nothing follows through" — **BORN FALSE, 2026-07-17 (aea1fda), and the cleanest case.** At birth the loop had NO CONDITION AT ALL: it reported every ANTICIPATES edge with that message while checking nothing about follow-through. False for every edge from the first line of code.
⑤ `Question.answer` "the design nodes it produced are linked separately" — **BORN FALSE, 2026-07-18 (069a28d).** The ANSWERS edge count in `nodes.rs` at that commit was ZERO. It described a structure that would not exist for 46 days.
⑥ `gap_to_prompt` "REPLAY UNCHANGED … re-keys every answer" — **THE ONE GENUINE ROT.** True when written 2026-08-23, made false by the guard fix on 2026-09-02 — and caught in the same session that broke it.

**TALLY: 4 BORN FALSE, 1 TRUE-THEN-ROTTED (caught within the hour), 1 NOT ACTUALLY FALSE.**

⭐ **SO THE PROSE DOES NOT ROT. IT IS BORN FALSE.** There is no ageing mechanism to defend against, which is why the survey found no rot by sampling and why age is uncorrelated with falsity.

⭐ **AND THE AUTHOR HAD THE CODE IN FRONT OF THEM.** In ① the computation and the sentence sit in one diff; in ④ the message describes a check that the same function visibly does not perform. The gap is not knowledge and not time — it is that a sentence describing a computation is written in a different mode from the computation, and NOTHING FORCES A COMPARISON AT THAT MOMENT.

**WHAT THIS CHANGES:**
· Auditing old prose is wrong, and MORE wrong than the prevalence survey said — not merely low-yield, but aimed at a mechanism that does not exist.
· "Pin the claims that can be pinned" survives, but its TIMING is the whole point: the pin must be written WITH the claim, at authoring time. A retrofitted test cannot catch a sentence that was false before it was committed.
· The untested alternative that made the earlier conclusion unsafe — "rot concentrates on heavily-used surfaces" — is IRRELEVANT to 4 of 6, because there is no wear. That hole is closed by a different route than the survey it threatened.

⚠️ BOUNDS: six instances, all found by users, so this is the population of KNOWN failures and not a sample of all prose. Birth dates come from `git log -S` on a distinctive phrase, which finds the commit that introduced the WORDING — a sentence reworded later would date to the rewording. ①④⑤ were each confirmed by reading the code AT that commit rather than inferring from the date.
